about: One Suggest rule for Models Fit Studio and zer0ne code. Both apps test against this file; the two copies must be the same (CoreTests/suggest-cases.json and zer0ne_code/engine/test/fixtures/suggest-cases.json). A row is [origin, paramsB, quality, typical tok/s, category]; the speed range is ±15% around it.

picks.name: the best mix, then the smartest, then the fastest
never slower than reading pace when a comfortable one exists
a weak computer still gets an answer
nothing that fits gives no suggestion

llmfit.about: llmfit 1.1.17 rows from an Arc 140T laptop (32 GB RAM), budget 16 GB: the decode rate comes from the first 200 rows, the suggestions from all of them.
